name: Status LEDs
description: Enable and configure NeoPixel status lights.

led_messages.label: Everything OK
led_messages.description: No error and no warning: DreamPi is ready or in a call, and the network and internet work.

led_messages.label: Error
led_messages.description: Anything critical: DreamPi not running, no network, no internet, under-voltage, over 80 °C or the modem missing.

led_messages.label: Warning
led_messages.description: Any warning or important information: DNS failing, slow connection, weak Wi-Fi, no IP address yet, throttled or warm, DCNET unavailable, a failed update, a failed Wi-Fi setup, an update available.

led_messages.label: Off (nothing else applies)
led_messages.description: Used when no other message is showing. Leave it out for dark LEDs, or give it a very dim colour.
